strong-bad-episode-3-baddest-of-the-band: A battle of the bands drives Strong Bad's Cool Game for Attractive People: Episode 3 - Baddest of the Bands, another 2008 chapter in Telltale's Homestar Runner series, also released on WiiWare.
quantum-of-solace: Both Casino Royale and the later Bond film are covered by the shooter Quantum of Solace (2008), and a Wii build used pointer aiming.
the-beatles-rock-band: Harmonix built The Beatles: Rock Band (2009) entirely from the Beatles catalog, the licensed band game Apple Corps allowed onto plastic instruments.
the-godfather-the-game: EA Redwood Shores adapted the film trilogy as the open-city crime game The Godfather: The Game (2006), and a Wii port followed the original consoles.
lostwinds: Frontier launched WiiWare with LostWinds (2008), drawing gusts on the screen so the wind can carry a hero across floating islands.
rock-band-3: A keytar and pro-difficulty parts for real instruments arrived in Harmonix's Rock Band 3 (2010), and the Wii release used that same band setup.
pes-2010: Konami shipped Pro Evolution Soccer 2010 in 2009, and the Wii edition favored motion kicks over the simulation controls of the other versions.
streets-of-rage: Sega's side-scrolling brawler Streets of Rage (1991) began on the Genesis, and Virtual Console later reissued it on Wii and Nintendo 3DS.
disney-universe: Players wear Disney character costumes through the four-player platform levels of Disney Universe (2011), which included a Wii release.
guitar-hero-5: Activision let any player drop into a song already in progress in Guitar Hero 5 (2009), a party-minded entry that also reached Wii.
dead-space-extraction: Eurocom's on-rails prequel Dead Space: Extraction (2009) debuted on Wii with pointer aiming, covering an earlier outbreak before a PlayStation 3 port.
nba-2k12: Visual Concepts put Michael Jordan on the cover of NBA 2K12 and built a Jordan Challenge from his career highlights, a 2011 release that also reached Wii.
silent-hill-shattered-memories: Climax reimagined the first Silent Hill as Silent Hill: Shattered Memories (2009), a Wii game with a psychological profile and no combat, later ported to PSP and PlayStation 2.
safecracker-the-ultimate-puzzle-adventur: Kheops Studio's mansion of combination locks, Safecracker: The Ultimate Puzzle Adventure, is a puzzle adventure about opening safes, later brought to Wii from PC.
rogue-trooper: Rebellion turned the 2000 AD comic into Rogue Trooper (2006), a third-person shooter about the blue Genetic Infantryman, with a Wii version years later.
manhunt-2: The UK refused to classify Rockstar's stealth sequel Manhunt 2 (2007) until scenes were cut, and the Wii release was caught in that same censorship fight.
just-dance-2019: Ubisoft still manufactured Just Dance 2019 for the original Wii and for Wii U in 2018, long after most publishers had left those consoles.
2010-fifa-world-cup: EA Sports' 2010 FIFA World Cup is the licensed tie-in to the tournament held in South Africa, and a Wii edition shipped with it.
luxor-3: Colored spheres have to be shot into rolling chains in MumboJumbo's Luxor 3 (2007), and a Wii version joined the casual PC original.
dragon-ball-z-budokai-tenkaichi-3: Spike's arena fighter Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3 (2007) fielded one of the largest rosters in that Dragon Ball line, released on Wii and PlayStation 2.
g-force: Disney's spy-guinea-pig film received the tie-in G-Force: The Video Game (2009), with separate Wii and DS builds beside the other consoles.
pirates-of-the-caribbean-at-worlds-end: The third film's licensed action game Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End (2007) shipped on Wii and DS along with the home-console versions.
resident-evil-the-umbrella-chronicles-2: Capcom retold the early Resident Evil outbreaks as the Wii light-gun game Resident Evil: The Umbrella Chronicles (2007), later reissued on the Wii U eShop.
mega-man-10: Capcom and Inti Creates followed Mega Man 9 with another 8-bit revival, Mega Man 10(2010), sold on WiiWare with the same limited lives and steep difficulty.
wwe-13: Yuke's built WWE '13 (2012) around an Attitude Era campaign, and the Wii edition shipped beside the HD wrestling games.
nba-2k13: Jay-Z was executive producer of NBA 2K13 (2012), the basketball season known for that curated soundtrack, and a Wii edition was included.
just-dance-2018: Ubisoft's pop-routine collection Just Dance 2018 reached stores in 2017 and was still sold for the original Wii.
madden-nfl-13: EA introduced the Infinity Engine on HD consoles in Madden NFL 13 (2012), while the Wii edition stayed on the older feature set.
bittrip-core: Gaijin Games' second WiiWare rhythm game, BIT.TRIP CORE (2009), bats beats back with a paddle.
bittrip-fate: Commander Video rides a continuous line in BIT.TRIP FATE (2010), a WiiWare chapter of Gaijin Games' rhythm series where every hit answers the music.
samurai-shodown-ii: SNK's weapons fighter SAMURAI SHODOWN II reached Neo Geo in 1994, and the Wii Virtual Console later sold that arcade game again.
secret-neighbor-beta: Hologryph's online hide-and-seek test Secret Neighbor Beta (2019) uses the Hello Neighbor house and was a PC beta, not a Wii release.
rooms-the-main-building: Doors only connect after the chambers slide into place in Rooms: The Main Building (2010), a puzzle released on WiiWare.
tales-of-graces-f: Namco's PlayStation 3 edition Tales of Graces f (2012) adds the future arc missing from the earlier Wii release of Tales of Graces.
brothers-in-arms-earned-in-blood: Another sergeant's squad retells the Normandy fighting in Brothers in Arms: Earned in Blood (2005), the follow-up Gearbox shipped the same year as Road to Hill 30.
the-simpsons-game: The family comments on being inside a video game in EA's platformer The Simpsons Game (2007), which has distinct Wii and DS versions.
secret-files-tunguska: Animation Arts built the point-and-click mystery Secret Files: Tunguska (2006) around the Tunguska explosion, and later ports reached Wii and DS.
just-dance-2017: Ubisoft's Just Dance 2017 is the 2016 tracklist, still sold as a disc for both Wii and Wii U.
dream-pinball-3d: Themed video-pinball tables fill Dream Pinball 3D (2006), and published editions reached both Wii and DS.
harry-potter-and-the-half-blood-prince: Motion-controlled spells carry the Wii build of EA's film tie-in Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince (2009), with a separate DS game for the sixth movie.
camerons-avatar: Ubisoft's James Cameron's AVATAR: The Game (2009) reached stores before James Cameron's film, and the Wii and DS editions are smaller than the HD versions.
doc-clock-the-toasted-sandwich-of-time: Stickmen Studios' WiiWare puzzle Doc Clock: The Toasted Sandwich of Time (2010) rotates each stage so the clockwork hero can cross the gaps.
spider-man-web-of-shadows: The black suit drives Activision's open-Manhattan game Spider-Man: Web of Shadows (2008), and the Wii version is its own build rather than the PS3 and Xbox 360 game.
trackmania-2010: Nadeo's restart-friendly time trials came to a living room as the 2010 Wii release of TrackMania.
disney-epic-mickey-2-the-power-of-two: Junction Point, led by Warren Spector, added Oswald as a co-op partner in Disney Epic Mickey 2: The Power of Two (2012), released on both Wii and Wii U.
tcs-hawx: Ubisoft's arcade dogfighter Tom Clancy's H.A.W.X. (2009) sits in the Clancy universe, and the Wii version used motion-assisted flying.
kung-fu-panda: The DreamWorks film became the brawler tie-in Kung Fu Panda (2008), with separate Wii and DS versions released alongside the movie.
transformers-the-game: Traveller's Tales tied Transformers: The Game (2007) to the first Michael Bay film, switching between robot and vehicle, including on Wii and DS.
guitar-hero-3-legends-of-rock: Neversoft's Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock (2007) is remembered for its cartoon guitar boss battles, and it was the first Guitar Hero packaged for Wii.
x-men-origins-wolverine: The bloodier Uncaged Edition of X-Men Origins: Wolverine (2009) on HD consoles outpaced the film's violence, while the Wii release was a separate, milder build.
virtua-tennis-4: Sega aimed Virtua Tennis 4 (2011) at motion controls, and the Wii version swings the remote as the racket.
golden-axe: Sega's fantasy brawler Golden Axe (1989) came from the arcades, and the Wii Virtual Console later reissued it rather than debuting it.
sam-max-season-1: Telltale's first six Sam and Max episodes are collected in Sam & Max Season One: Save the World (2007), and a Wii version packaged that season for the console.
flight-control-hd: Firemint's path-drawing air-traffic puzzle Flight Control HD (2010) is the console upgrade of the phone game, routing planes so they never collide.
guitar-hero-world-tour: Drums and vocals turned the series into a full band in Guitar Hero World Tour (2008), and the Wii edition supported that same four-instrument set.
okami: Clover Studio's paintbrush adventure Okami (2006) began on PlayStation 2, and the Wii port mapped the celestial brush to pointer controls.
mdk2: BioWare's sequel MDK 2 (2000) followed Shiny's MDK as a third-person shooter on PC, Dreamcast, and PlayStation 2, not as a Wii debut.
driver-parallel-lines: Reflections split a New York crime story between 1978 and a later era in Driver: Parallel Lines, and the 2006 original later received a Wii port.
bejeweled-2: PopCap followed its breakthrough match-three with Bejeweled 2 (2004), adding puzzle and endless modes on top of swapping gems.
sengoku: SNK's SENGOKU Anthology collects the three Sengoku arcade brawlers, demon-fighting beat-em-ups released on PC and PlayStation 2 rather than Wii.
disney-infinity: Avalanche Software's toys-to-life sandbox Disney Infinity (2013) unlocks Disney play sets with plastic figures, including Wii, Wii U, and a separate 3DS game.
428-shibuya-scramble: Chunsoft's live-action sound novel began on Wii in Japan, and the 2018 international release of 428: Shibuya Scramble brought that branching Shibuya story west.
de-blob-2: Blue Tongue's de Blob 2 (2011) continues the paint-the-city platforming of the original, and THQ included a Wii version at launch.
syberia: Benoit Sokal's point-and-click Syberia (2002) follows a clockwork journey east, later ported to DS and, much later, to Switch.
grid: Codemasters rebuilt its circuit-racing line as GRID (2008), and the DS release is a separate handheld rather than that console sim.
plants-vs-zombies-goty-edition: PopCap's expanded reissue Plants vs. Zombies GOTY Edition (2010) adds extras on top of the lawn-defense original, including a music video and further modes.
the-sims-3: EA's life sim The Sims 3 (2009) opened whole neighborhoods instead of a single lot, while the DS and 3DS editions are smaller separate games.
plants-vs-zombies: George Fan's lawn-defense comedy Plants vs. Zombies (2009) made PopCap a household name, and a DS version later recreated those lanes on a handheld.
bejeweled-3: Quest modes and new gem powers surround the classic grid in PopCap's Bejeweled 3 (2010), the match-three follow-up best known on PC.
sonic-sega-all-stars-racing: Sumo Digital packed Sega characters into the kart racer Sonic & SEGA All-Stars Racing (2010), and both Wii and DS received their own versions.
mx-vs-atv-reflex: Rainbow Studios' off-road racer MX vs. ATV Reflex (2009) is known for leaning the rider to shift weight, with a separate DS release.
dirt-2: Codemasters' festival off-road racer Colin McRae: DiRT 2 (2009) has reduced Wii and DS editions that are not the HD game.
star-wars-the-force-unleashed: LucasArts' Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (2008) follows a secret apprentice between the film trilogies, and the Wii and DS versions were built apart from the HD consoles.
agatha-christie-the-abc-murders: Artefacts Studio's point-and-click Agatha Christie - The ABC Murders (2016) adapts the Poirot novel, a different game from the earlier DS title that used the same book.
nfs-prostreet: EA Black Box turned the series toward sanctioned race days in Need for Speed: ProStreet (2007), leaving open-road police chases behind, with Wii and DS versions.
transformers-wfc: High Moon Studios set Transformers: War for Cybertron (2010) on the robots' home world, a licensed shooter praised well beyond the usual tie-in, while Wii and DS got separate games.
lego-indiana-jones-2: TT Games' LEGO Indiana Jones 2: The Adventure Continues (2009) covers the fourth film and rebuilds scenes from the earlier movies, on Wii and DS as well.
might-and-magic-clash-of-heroes: Capybara Games debuted the puzzle RPG Might and Magic Clash of Heroes (2009) on DS, matching colored troops in rows before an HD remake spread elsewhere.
steamworld-heist: Image and Form's turn-based crew shooter SteamWorld Heist (2015) makes ricochet shots the main trick, first on 3DS and later on Wii U.
ducktales-remastered: WayForward rebuilt Capcom's NES pogo-jump classic as DuckTales: Remastered (2013), and Wii U was one of the platforms for that remake.
octodad-dadliest-catch: Young Horses' physics comedy Octodad: Dadliest Catch (2014) asks you to puppeteer an octopus through ordinary chores, and a Wii U port followed PC.
qube-directors-cut: Toxic Games expanded its first-person cube puzzles in Q.U.B.E: Director's Cut (2014), and that longer edition reached Wii U.
shantae-and-the-pirates-curse: WayForward shipped Shantae and the Pirate's Curse (2014) on 3DS and Wii U, a pirate-gear platformer in the half-genie series.
teslagrad: Rain Games' wordless platformer Teslagrad (2013) uses magnetism inside a tower, and a Wii U port followed the PC release.
back-to-bed: Bedtime Digital's Back to Bed (2014) guides a sleepwalker across Escher-like paths by placing objects in his way.
ziggurat: Milkstone Studios' first-person dungeon crawl Ziggurat (2014) randomizes floors and arms a wizard with wands, later appearing on Wii U.
bittrip-presents-runner2-future-legend-o: Gaijin Games added branching paths timed to the soundtrack in BIT.TRIP Presents... Runner2: Future Legend of Rhythm Alien (2013), the auto-runner sequel, including a Wii U version.
shovel-knight: Yacht Club Games' Kickstarter homage Shovel Knight (2014) revives NES-style action, and it launched on Wii U and 3DS as well as PC.
the-cave: Ron Gilbert made The Cave (2013) at Double Fine, an adventure about seven wanderers exploring one cavern, Wii U included.
unepic: A pizza-delivery worker trapped in a castle is the joke inside Unepic (2011), a PC Metroidvania parody later ported to the Wii U eShop.
lego-movie-videogame: TT Games retold the film in brick form as The LEGO Movie - Videogame (2014), released on Wii U and 3DS with the movie.
lego-star-wars-tfa: TT Games' brick version of the seventh Star Wars film, LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens (2016), adds scenes between the movie's beats on Wii U and 3DS.
road-redemption: Motorcycle combat in the spirit of Road Rash is the pitch of Road Redemption (2014), which first appeared through PC early access rather than on Wii U.
lone-survivor-the-directors-cut: Jasper Byrne expanded his 2D survival horror as Lone Survivor: The Director's Cut, the 2012 game's larger edition, and a Wii U port followed.
lego-marvels-avengers: The first two Avengers films get the brick treatment in TT Games' LEGO Marvel's Avengers (2016), which shipped on Wii U and 3DS.
edge: The cube-rolling puzzle Edge (2011) grew out of an earlier mobile game, and later Wii U and 3DS versions carried that same rolling challenge.
lego-jurassic-world: TT Games retold the first four Jurassic films as LEGO Jurassic World (2015), with releases on Wii U and 3DS.
forced: BetaDwarf's co-op arena game FORCED (2013) sends fighters through trials while spirit orbs rewrite their abilities.
human-resource-machine: Tomorrow Corporation set the visual programming puzzles of Human Resource Machine (2015) in a dreary office, launching on Wii U alongside PC.
axiom-verge: Tom Happ built the Metroidvania Axiom Verge (2015) alone, using glitches as weapons, and a Wii U version followed PC and PlayStation 4.
pinball-arcade: FarSight Studios licensed real Williams and Bally machines for Pinball Arcade (2012), a digital pinball collection that included a Wii U version.
blackgate-deluxe-ed: Armature's handheld Metroidvania moved to home consoles as Batman: Arkham Origins Blackgate - Deluxe Edition (2014), a Wii U edition with extra maps from the Blackgate side story.
minecraft-story-mode-complete: Telltale's episodic, choice-driven take on Minecraft is Minecraft: Story Mode (2015), and a Wii U release carried that season.
the-fall: Over the Moon Games' The Fall (2014) follows a combat suit's artificial intelligence, and that adventure was ported to Wii U.
olliolli: Roll7's skateboard game OlliOlli (2014) is all timed tricks and landings, born on PlayStation Vita and later ported to Wii U and 3DS.
tumblestone: Pulling runs of matching blocks out of columns is the versus puzzle Tumblestone (2016), which launched with a Wii U version.
mighty-no-9: Keiji Inafune's Kickstarter action game Mighty No. 9 (2016), developed with Inti Creates, was widely received as a troubled Mega Man successor, and it did reach Wii U and 3DS.
toki-tori-2: Two Tribes refused text tutorials in Toki Tori 2+ (2013), so each creature's effect has to be learned by trying it, and Wii U was a lead platform.
lovely-planet: Tiny stages and a single-shot rhythm define Lovely Planet (2014), a brightly colored first-person game from quicktequila.
rush: Two Tribes' cube-routing puzzle RUSH (2010) uses conveyors and warps to reach colored exits, and a later Wii U version plays on the GamePad.
shovel-knight-treasure-trove: Yacht Club bundled the later knight campaigns with the original in Shovel Knight: Treasure Trove, gathering the 2014 game and its expansions on Wii U and 3DS.
slender-the-arrival: Blue Isle's commercial horror game Slender: The Arrival (2013) followed the free Slender demo and the internet myth that spawned it.
lego-city-undercover: TT Fusion's open-city police comedy Lego City Undercover (2013) began as a Wii U exclusive and used the GamePad as a map before ports years later.
sky-force-anniversary: Infinite Dreams rebuilt its vertical shooter as Sky Force Anniversary (2015), a score-chasing shmup that also reached Wii U.
stick-it-to-the-man: Zoink's comedy platformer Stick it to The Man! (2013) gives the hero a spaghetti arm that slaps stickers onto other people's thoughts.
volgarr-the-viking: Ghosts 'n Goblins is the model for the harsh arcade platformer Volgarr the Viking (2013), which later showed up on the Wii U eShop.
140-itch: Jeppe Carlsen's one-button platformer 140 (2013) pulses its geometry in time with the music.
nihilumbra: BeautiFun Games' Nihilumbra (2012) paints colors onto the ground to change how it behaves, a mobile puzzle-platformer later brought to Wii U.
xeodrifter: Renegade Kid's pocket Metroidvania Xeodrifter (2014) hops a drifter between tiny planets on 3DS and Wii U.
earthlock: Snowcastle Games' Norwegian turn-based RPG EARTHLOCK: Festival of Magic (2016) is that studio's debut project.
whispering-willows: A girl who can step out of her body is the hook of the ghost-story adventure Whispering Willows (2014), which was ported to Wii U.
freedom-planet: GalaxyTrail's fast platformer Freedom Planet (2014) is often set beside classic Sonic, and a Wii U port followed the PC release.
costume-quest-2: Double Fine returned to Halloween costume battles in Costume Quest 2 (2014), a sequel that shipped on Wii U.
shantae-riskys-revenge-directors-cut: WayForward upgraded its DSiWare sequel for home consoles as Shantae: Risky's Revenge - Director's Cut (2014), including a Wii U version.
electronic-super-joy: Electronic music backs the tough platforming of Electronic Super Joy (2013), an indie originally on PC and later on Wii U.
nova-111: Turn-based steps share a grid with real-time blasts in Nova-111 (2015), an indie hybrid released on Wii U.
ultratron: Puppy Games' twin-stick homage to Robotron is Ultratron, first on PC and later brought to Wii U by Curve Digital.
the-swindle: Size Five Games' steampunk heist The Swindle (2015) lays out each burglary differently before a final score, and a Wii U version was sold.
pumped-bmx: Timed flips on a side-view bike course define Pumped BMX + (2015), an indie trick racer on the Wii U eShop.
castlestorm: Zen Studios mixed castle defense with physics projectiles in CastleStorm (2013), and a Wii U version followed.
shutshimi: Power-ups are absurd and temporary in the short horizontal shooter Shutshimi (2015), an indie arcade game on Wii U.
chariot: Hauling a royal coffin through treasure caves is the co-op platforming of Chariot (2014), released on Wii U.
sonic-lost-world: Sonic Team built parkour on floating continents for the Wii U game Sonic Lost World (2013), and the 3DS version uses its own stages.
year-walk: Simogo's folklore horror Year Walk (2013) began on phones, where a companion app held extra clues, and a Wii U port came later.
frederic-resurrection-of-music: A revived Chopin stars in Forever Entertainment's rhythm game Frederic: Resurrection of Music (2012), a Polish indie later sold on Wii U.
citizens-of-earth: Recruiting ordinary townspeople as party members is the joke of the turn-based RPG Citizens of Earth (2015), on Wii U and 3DS.
starwhal: Local multiplayer narwhals poke each other in space in STARWHAL (2014), a couch game that included a Wii U version.
fifa-13: EA Sports brought FIFA 13 (2012) to Wii U in that console's launch window, with an edition that was not the HD consoles' feature set.
guitar-hero-live: FreeStyleGames restarted the series as Guitar Hero Live (2015), using first-person live-action crowds and a new guitar instead of the old five-color notes, Wii U included.
ittle-dew: Ludosity's short dungeon-puzzle adventure Ittle Dew (2013) is a Swedish homage to classic top-down quests, released on Wii U.
knytt-underground: Nifflas' long subterranean wander Knytt Underground (2012) favors exploration over combat, and it reached the Wii U eShop.
spy-chameleon: Changing color to stay hidden is the entire puzzle of Spy Chameleon - RGB Agent (2014), a Wii U eShop release about a chameleon agent.
shantae-half-genie-hero: WayForward's Kickstarter return Shantae: Half-Genie Hero (2016) brought the half-genie back in HD, and Wii U was one of the launch platforms.
ballpoint-universe-infinite: Ink on paper is the look of the shooter Ballpoint Universe - Infinite (2013), a ballpoint-styled arcade game that received a Wii U release.
puddle: Tilting a bead of liquid through machinery is the physics puzzle Puddle (2012), which later reached the Wii U eShop.
scribblenauts-unmasked-a-dc-comics-adven: 5th Cell set its word-summoning puzzles inside the DC universe for Scribblenauts Unmasked: A DC Comics Adventure (2013), on Wii U and 3DS.
plantera: Gentle plant-raising fills the small gardening sim Plantera (2016), released on 3DS and Wii U.
space-hulk: Games Workshop's squad board game became Space Hulk (2013), with Terminators clearing a derelict ship, and a Wii U edition was released.
gravity-badgers: Wales Interactive's Gravity Badgers (2013) launches badgers through caves by flipping gravity, a physics puzzle on the Wii U eShop.
mutant-mudds-deluxe: Renegade Kid expanded its 3DS platformer as Mutant Mudds Deluxe (2013), adding levels for a Wii U release of that deluxe set.
kung-fu-panda-showdown-of-legendary-lege: DreamWorks characters brawl on floating stages in the platform fighter Kung Fu Panda: Showdown of Legendary Legends (2015), released on Wii U and 3DS.
dungeons-dragons-chronicles-of-mystara: Capcom bundled its arcade beat-em-ups Tower of Doom and Shadow over Mystara as Dungeons & Dragons: Chronicles of Mystara (2013), and that collection reached Wii U.
quest-of-dungeons: A compact roguelike crawl, Quest of Dungeons (2014) generates small dungeons and shipped on Wii U and 3DS.
shiftlings: Two aliens share one body in the co-op game Shiftlings (2015), sold on the Wii U eShop.
girls-like-robots: Adult Swim Games published the seating-chart puzzle Girls Like Robots (2012), later brought to Wii U.
tekken-tag-tournament-2: Namco's tag-team fighter Tekken Tag Tournament 2 (2012) pairs a huge roster, and the Wii U version added modes the arcade release lacked.
jones-on-fire: A firefighter outruns the blaze in the short runner Jones On Fire (2015), an indie sold on the Wii U eShop.
the-book-of-unwritten-tales-2: KING Art's comedy point-and-click sequel The Book of Unwritten Tales 2 (2015) followed the PC adventure with a Wii U port.
draculas-legacy: Jetdogs Studios' hidden-object adventure Dracula's Legacy (2015) uses a vampire theme, and a Wii U eShop port followed the PC release.
angry-video-game-nerd-adventures: The web-series host becomes a deliberately harsh retro platformer in Angry Video Game Nerd Adventures (2013), released on Wii U and 3DS.
woah-dave: Choice Provisions' one-screen arcade scuffle Woah Dave! (2014) is a small multiplayer throwback on Wii U and 3DS.
master-reboot: Wales Interactive set the first-person horror game Master Reboot (2013) inside a machine that stores memories, and released it on Wii U.
forma8: A small probe crosses an alien surface with no dialogue in forma.8 (2017), an exploration game brought to Wii U.
ninja-pizza-girl: Delivery runs and schoolyard cruelty share the momentum platformer Ninja Pizza Girl (2015), an Australian indie on Wii U.
bridge-constructor-playground: Stress-testing homemade spans with vehicles is the sandbox Bridge Constructor Playground (2012), a physics playground from the bridge-building series on Wii U.
armikrog: The Neverhood team returned with clay animation in the Kickstarted point-and-click Armikrog (2015), later sold on Wii U.
letter-quest-remastered-2: Bacon Bandit Games mixes spelling with monster battles in Letter Quest: Remastered (2016), a word RPG whose remaster reached Wii U.
1001-spikes: Nicalis published the cruel temple platformer 1001 Spikes (2014), a spike-filled arcade challenge on Wii U and 3DS.
the-deer-god: Pixel-art reincarnation as a deer is the premise of The Deer God (2015), a side-scroller released on Wii U among other platforms.
injustice-gods-among-us: NetherRealm's DC Comics fighter Injustice: Gods Among Us (2013) reached Wii U with the same one-on-one battles as the other consoles.
severed: Drinkbox Studios built the first-person slash adventure Severed (2016) for touch controls, and released it on Wii U and 3DS.
tengami: Nyamyam styled the puzzle adventure Tengami (2014) as a pop-up paper book, a Wii U eShop release.
tetrobot-and-co: Swing Swing Submarine's block-pushing puzzle Tetrobot and Co. (2013) was ported to Wii U after its other digital releases.
world-of-keflings-a: NinjaBee's toy-like god game A World of Keflings (2010) has you helping tiny villagers by hand, and a Wii U version followed the Xbox original.
giana-sisters-twisted-dreams-directors-c: Black Forest Games revived the 1980s series with Giana Sisters: Twisted Dreams - Director's Cut, a hard fantasy platformer whose expanded cut reached Wii U in 2014.
extreme-exorcism: Your previous life replays as a ghost in the party game Extreme Exorcism (2015), a local multiplayer idea sold on Wii U.
electronic-super-joy-groove-city: A new city of music-driven stages continues the tough platforming in Electronic Super Joy: Groove City (2014), including a Wii U version.
pirate-pop-plus: 13AM Games dressed a bubble-popping arcade game like a tiny handheld in Pirate Pop Plus (2016), on 3DS and Wii U.
zombie-defense: Placing units against incoming waves is the defense game Zombie Defense (2010), later sold on the Wii U eShop.
cubemen-2: 3 Sprockets' blocky strategy game Cubemen 2 (2013) lets cube squads attack each other's bases, and Nnooo brought cross-platform matches to Wii U.
super-toy-cars: Miniature cars race household-sized tracks in Super Toy Cars (2014), an indie racer on the Wii U eShop.
warriors-orochi-3-ultimate: Koei Tecmo folded Dynasty Warriors and Samurai Warriors into the giant crossover WARRIORS OROCHI 3 Ultimate (2013), and the Wii U edition was part of that Ultimate set.
mahjong-deluxe-3: Solitaire tile-matching on the Wii U eShop is Mahjong Deluxe 3 (2016), a late casual release for that shop.
lone-survivor: Jasper Byrne's 2D survival horror Lone Survivor (2012) is the original PC release, later expanded by a director's cut.
level-22: Sneaking an office worker past patrolling managers is the top-down stealth puzzle Level 22: Gary’s Misadventure - 2016 Edition.
lego-dimensions: TT Games' toys-to-life kit LEGO DIMENSIONS (2015) drops many Warner licenses into one brick world, and Wii U had a starter set.
twd-survival-instinct: Activision's first-person spinoff The Walking Dead: Survival Instinct (2013) is separate from Telltale's episodic series and was widely panned, including a Wii U release.
just-dance-2016: Ubisoft introduced the Just Dance Unlimited streaming library with Just Dance 2016 in 2015, while a Wii U disc still held an on-disc tracklist.
shiny-the-firefly: Padaone Games ported the mobile garden game Shiny The Firefly to Wii U, where a firefly's glow both leads the way and draws danger.
sonic-generations: Classic and modern Sonics share Sonic Generations (2011) for the series anniversary, and the 3DS version uses its own stages rather than the console levels.
vvvvvv: Terry Cavanagh's VVVVVV (2010) flips gravity instead of jumping, a PC platformer later ported to 3DS and Switch.
steamworld-dig-2: Image and Form sent a new robot into a larger mine in SteamWorld Dig 2 (2017), a dig-and-upgrade sequel on 3DS and Switch.
punch-club: Lazy Bear Games' pixel-art boxing manager Punch Club (2016) is about training and fight nights, and it reached 3DS.
fifa-15: EA Sports' FIFA 15 (2014) is that season's football sim, and the 3DS edition is a simplified handheld, not the Ignite-engine console game.
mega-man-legacy-collection-2: Capcom gathered the first six Mega Man games, plus extra challenges, in Mega Man Legacy Collection / ロックマン クラシックス コレクション (2015), and a 3DS version followed the console release.
nightsky: Nifflas rolls a silhouetted orb through quiet stages in NightSky (2011), a puzzle later brought to 3DS.
retro-city-rampage-dx: Brian Provinciano's 8-bit open-city crime parody Retro City Rampage DX (2012) expanded on 3DS as the DX edition of his PC original.
metal-gear-solid-3-snake-eater: Hideo Kojima's jungle-survival stealth game Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater (2004) began on PlayStation 2, and a 3DS version later carried that same mission.
dragon-quest-xi: Square Enix's mainline RPG DRAGON QUEST XI: Echoes of an Elusive Age (2017) launched in Japan on 3DS beside PlayStation 4.
ace-attorney-phoenix-wright-trilogy-hd: Capcom's Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy packages the first three courtroom games, the cases that began on the Game Boy Advance.
ghostbusters-the-video-game: Dan Aykroyd and Harold Ramis helped write Ghostbusters: The Video Game (2009), often treated as a third film, while the Wii version is a separate on-rails take.
lego-pirates-of-the-caribbean: TT Games retold four films in brick form as LEGO Pirates of the Caribbean: The Video Game (2011), shipping on Wii, DS, and 3DS.
gauntlet: The four-hero dungeon crawl that Midway made famous in arcades lends its name to Gauntlet (2009), a DS-era release rather than the 1985 cabinet.
marvel-ultimate-alliance-2: The comics' registration conflict becomes a team brawler in Marvel: Ultimate Alliance 2 (2009), with separate Wii and DS versions of that Marvel game.
ys-i-ii-chronicles-2: Falcom's remake package Ys I & II Chronicles bundles the first two Ys action RPGs, and that Chronicles edition is associated with PSP rather than a DS launch.
zumas-revenge: PopCap's sequel Zuma's Revenge! (2009) continues the frog-and-marble matching of Zuma, firing colored balls into rolling chains.
tron-evolution: Propaganda Games tied TRON: Evolution - The Video Game (2010) to TRON: Legacy, and the DS release is a separate handheld from the console action game.
cut-the-rope: ZeptoLab's Cut the Rope (2010) swings candy to a small monster by slicing ropes, and DS and 3DS ports followed the phone original.
tcs-endwar: Voice commands made Ubisoft's near-future strategy game Tom Clancy's EndWar (2008) famous on consoles, while the DS version is a separate handheld campaign.
myst: Cyan's pre-rendered island puzzle Myst (1993) was a point-and-click landmark on home computers, and a DS port arrived years after the Macintosh original.
puzzle-kingdoms: Infinite Interactive's strategy-puzzle hybrid Puzzle Kingdoms (2009) is a DS cousin of Puzzle Quest, mixing match puzzles with a kingdom map.
kingdom-hearts-3582-days: Square Enix told a mission-based chapter of the series on DS as Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days (2009), later folded into HD collections.
gta-chinatown-wars: Rockstar Leeds' top-down DS original Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars (2009) is a Liberty City crime story praised far above a typical handheld spinoff.
carcassonne-2: The tile-laying board game came to DS as Carcassonne (2010), scoring cities, roads, and fields the way the tabletop original does.
lotr-conquest: Pandemic set the battle game The Lord of the Rings: Conquest (2009) in the film trilogy's wars, and the DS edition is a smaller companion to the console release.
n-2: Metanet's punishing jumper reached DS as N+ (2008), an expanded edition of N with a large stack of user levels.
dragons-lair-hd: Don Bluth's laserdisc arcade cartoon returned as Dragon's Lair HD (2009), the quick-time fantasy played as animated scenes rather than free movement.
7-wonders-ii: MumboJumbo's tile-matcher 7 Wonders II (2007) is the sequel in that casual line of ancient-wonder puzzles.
puzzler-world: Crosswords, word searches, and logic grids from the Puzzler brand fill the DS compilation Puzzler World (2009).
wwe-smackdown-vs-raw-2010: THQ and Yuke's shipped the annual wrestling sim WWE SmackDown vs. RAW 2010 in 2009, DS edition included.
fifa-08: EA Sports' football season FIFA 08 arrived in 2007, with a DS edition beside the console game.
iron-man: Sega's action tie-in to the first Marvel film is Iron Man (2008), and a DS version was part of that licensed set.
kingdom-hearts-recoded: Square Enix remade its mobile Kingdom Hearts story for DS as KINGDOM HEARTS Re:coded (2010), a journal-data chapter later compiled in HD.
mario-and-luigi-bowsers-inside-story: AlphaDream split the DS role-playing game Mario and Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story (2009) between the brothers and a giant Bowser they travel inside.
lego-rock-band: Harmonix and Traveller's Tales aimed Lego Rock Band (2009) at younger players, and the DS edition is a simpler rhythm game than the console instruments.
zoo-tycoon: Blue Fang and Microsoft's zoo-building sim Zoo Tycoon (2001) is a PC management game, distinct from the later DS spinoff that reused the name.
dark-void-zero: Capcom released the 8-bit side-scroller Dark Void Zero (2010) on DSiWare as a retro prequel tied to the bigger Dark Void shooter.
7-wonders-of-the-ancient-world: MumboJumbo themed the tile-matcher 7 Wonders of the Ancient World (2007) on ancient monuments, and a DS version joined the casual PC original.
smackdown-vs-raw-2009: THQ's wrestling season WWE Smackdown vs. RAW 2009 arrived in 2008, with a DS edition of that annual.
spider-man-friend-or-foe: Activision's lighter team brawler Spider-Man: Friend or Foe (2007) is a kid-aimed Spider-Man, and a DS version shipped with it.
apollo-justice-ace-attorney-2: Capcom introduced a new defense attorney on DS in Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney (2007), the fourth main courtroom game after the Phoenix Wright trilogy.
the-incredible-hulk: The Marvel film named in the title received the action tie-in The Incredible Hulk (2008), and a DS version shipped with the other editions.
madden-nfl-09: EA's Madden NFL 09 put Brett Favre on the cover in a Packers jersey for the 2008 season, then issued a Jets cover after he changed teams. The Nintendo DS cart is that year's handheld edition, not a later Madden.
bolt: The animated film about a TV dog got the platform tie-in Disney Bolt (2008), and a DS version shipped in that movie season.
secret-files-2-puritas-cordis: Animation Arts followed Tunguska with the point-and-click sequel Secret Files 2: Puritas Cordis (2009), including a DS port of that mystery.
puzzle-quest-2: Infinite Interactive's match-puzzle RPG Puzzle Quest 2 (2010) continues the Puzzle Quest idea, and a DS version was part of the release.
thrillville-otr: Frontier's theme-park sequel Thrillville: Off the Rails (2007) mixes roller-coaster building with minigames, including a DS version.
layton-diabolical-box-in-hd: Level-5's second DS puzzle adventure Professor Layton and the Diabolical Box (2009) followed the curious village with another suitcase of riddles, known in Europe as Pandora's Box.
4-elements: Matching elemental tokens to clear boards is the casual puzzle 4 Elements (2010), and editions were sold on DS and 3DS.
harry-potter-and-the-deathly-hallows-par: EA turned the seventh film into the cover shooter Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1 (2010), a sharp break from the earlier Potter adventures, with a DS version.
ace-attorney-investigations-miles-edgewo: Capcom moved the courtroom series onto investigation scenes with Ace Attorney Investigations - Miles Edgeworth (2009), a DS game starring the prosecutor instead of the defense.
sudoku: The pencil-and-paper number grid comes to DS as Sudoku (2008), one of many handheld editions of a logic puzzle that long predates Nintendo.
madden-nfl-08: EA's Madden NFL 08 (2007) still shipped on GameCube as well as DS, among the last Madden seasons on Nintendo's disc console.
sonic-colors: Alien Wisps that change moves define Sonic Team's Sonic Colors (2010), and the DS version is its own stage set rather than a shrunk Wii port.
professor-layton-and-the-unwound-future: Level-5 closed its original DS puzzle trilogy with Professor Layton and the Unwound Future (2010), known in Europe as Professor Layton and the Lost Future.
pokemon-mystery-dungeon-explorers-of-sky: Chunsoft's expanded third version of the Explorers story is Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky (2009), adding episodes on top of Time and Darkness for DS.
wall-e: THQ's tie-in to the Pixar film is WALL-E: The Video Game (2008), and the DS edition was part of that licensed set.
puzzle-quest-galactrix: Infinite Interactive moved the Puzzle Quest formula onto a hex grid for the sci-fi spinoff Puzzle Quest: Galactrix (2009), including a DS release.
pokemon-ranger: Capturing with stylus loops, rather than battles, is the DS spinoff Pokémon Ranger (2006), the first game in that handheld line.
cars-2-the-video-game: The spy sequel's racing tie-in Disney•Pixar Cars 2: The Video Game (2011) shipped with DS and 3DS versions alongside the consoles.
sonic-sega-racing: Sega characters fill the DS kart game Sonic & SEGA Racing (2010), a handheld cousin of Sumo Digital's All-Stars Racing.
shrek-the-third: The third DreamWorks film received the tie-in Shrek the Third (2007), and a DS version was part of that licensed set.
harry-potter-and-the-deathly-hallows-par: EA's cover-shooter tie-in to the eighth film is Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2 (2011), with a DS version beside the consoles.
spider-man-edge-of-time: The modern hero shares Spider-Man: Edge of Time (2011) with Spider-Man 2099, and the DS and 3DS releases are separate from the HD console game.
alice-in-wonderland: Tim Burton's film received the tie-in Disney Alice in Wonderland (2010), and a DS version launched in that movie's season.
fifa-street-3: EA dropped simulation rules for trick-heavy street football in FIFA Street 3 (2008), and a DS version carried that arcade spinoff.
world-of-zoo: THQ's animal-care sim World of Zoo (2009) plays closer to toy creatures than to the older Zoo Tycoon management model, with a DS release.
castlevania-order-of-ecclesia: Koji Igarashi's DS action-RPG Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia (2008) was the last of the handheld search-action Castlevanias before the series changed direction.
superman-returns: EA's open-city tie-in to the film is Superman Returns: The Videogame (2006), and a separate DS game shipped with that license.
band-hero: Activision's pop-leaning Guitar Hero spinoff Band Hero (2009) has a DS edition that is a simpler rhythm game than the console band set.
labyrinth: Ravensburger's shifting-maze board game came to DS as Labyrinth (2008), sliding tiles to open a path.
the-witcher-3-wild-hunt: CD Projekt Red's open-world RPG The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt (2015) won a pile of year-end awards, and a demanding Switch port followed in a later year.
portal: Valve's 2007 puzzle game Portal uses a gun that links two holes in space, and the Companion Collection later brought it to Switch.
the-elder-scrolls-v-skyrim: Bethesda's open-world fantasy The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim (2011) became one of the most re-released RPGs of its decade, including a 2017 Switch port.
bioshock-infinite: Irrational Games set BioShock Infinite (2013) in the floating city of Columbia, a sky-line shooter later included in the Switch collection.
limbo: Playdead's silhouette puzzle-platformer Limbo (2010) was a breakout indie, and a Switch port followed the original releases.
doom: id Software rebooted the series as a fast, aggressive shooter in DOOM (2016), and Panic Button later brought that campaign to Switch.
cyberpunk-2077: CD Projekt Red's Night City RPG Cyberpunk 2077 (2020) launched in a famously broken state and was rebuilt over years of patches.
warframe: Digital Extremes' free-to-play squad shooter Warframe (2013) has run as a live game for years, and a Switch version joined it.
rocket-league: Psyonix turned cars playing soccer into Rocket League (2015), a surprise hit sequel to Supersonic Acrobatic Rocket-Powered Battle-Cars, later on Switch.
batman-arkham-knight: Rocksteady closed its Arkham series with Batman: Arkham Knight (2015), built around the Batmobile on PC and that generation's HD consoles.
apex-legends: Respawn's free squad shooter Apex Legends (2019) spun a battle royale out of the Titanfall universe.
hollow-knight: Team Cherry's hand-drawn bug kingdom Hollow Knight (2017) became a landmark indie, and the Switch version was part of its wide release.
the-walking-dead: Telltale's choice-driven adaptation of the comic, The Walking Dead: Season 1 (2012), revived the studio's reputation and later reached Switch.
little-nightmares: Tarsier Studios' Little Nightmares (2017) shrinks the player inside a giant, hostile ship, and a Switch port followed.
bioshock-2: 2K Marin put the player in a Big Daddy's suit for BioShock 2 (2010), a return to Rapture after the original.
stardew-valley: ConcernedApe built the farming life sim Stardew Valley (2016) largely alone, and the Switch version became one of its biggest platforms.
hotline-miami: Dennaton's top-down violence puzzle Hotline Miami (2012) is scored like a club track, and a Switch port came later.
bioshock-remastered: Irrational's 2007 Rapture shooter was polished up as BioShock Remastered (2016), and that remaster later sat inside the Switch collection.
outlast: Red Barrels' Outlast (2013) is a horror game about filming an asylum with a camcorder and no weapons, later ported to Switch.
hellblade-senuas-sacrifice: Ninja Theory developed Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice (2017) with mental-health advisors, and a Switch port followed the PC and console release.
hitman-absolution: IO Interactive made Hitman: Absolution (2012) a more linear Agent 47 story, the follow-up to Blood Money before the World of Assassination reboot.
la-noire: Team Bondi's detective game L.A. Noire (2011), published by Rockstar, is famous for facial-capture interrogations, and it was later ported to Switch.
metro-last-light-redux: 4A Games' post-nuclear sequel was cleaned up as Metro: Last Light Redux (2014), part of the Redux pair later brought to Switch.
metro-redux: 4A Games rebuilt its Moscow-metro shooter on a newer engine as Metro 2033 Redux (2014), and that Redux edition later reached Switch.
hades-2018: Supergiant's roguelike Hades (2020) left early access to huge acclaim, built around repeated escape attempts, and the finished game launched on Switch at the same time.
bioshock-2-remastered: The same remaster wave that updated the first Rapture game produced BioShock 2 Remastered (2016), a cleaner release of 2K Marin's sequel.
nierautomata: PlatinumGames and director Yoko Taro made NieR:Automata (2017) the series' breakout action RPG, later ported to Switch.
fall-guys: Mediatonic's obstacle-course brawl Fall Guys: Ultimate Knockout (2020) became a costume knockout show and later went free-to-play, including on Switch.
resident-evil-7-biohazard: Capcom switched the series to a first-person haunted house with Resident Evil 7: Biohazard (2017), a softer reboot after years of action-heavy sequels.
bastion: Supergiant's debut Bastion (2011) is an action RPG whose narrator comments on what the player just did, later ported to Switch.
paladins: Hi-Rez Studios' free hero shooter Paladins (2016) joined the wave of class-based team games, with a Switch version following.
ark-survival-evolved: Studio Wildcard's dinosaur survival sandbox ARK: Survival Evolved (2015) is enormous on PC, and the Switch port was a notably compromised version of that world.
cities-skylines: Colossal Order's city builder Cities: Skylines (2015) picked up players after SimCity's troubled relaunch, and a Switch port followed.
undertale: Toby Fox's RPG Undertale (2015) lets players spare monsters instead of fighting them, a surprise hit later brought to Switch.
unturned: Teen developer Nelson Sexton released the free zombie survival game Unturned (2014), which spread widely on PC.
brothers-a-tale-of-two-sons-2: Josef Fares' adventure Brothers: A Tale of Two Sons (2013) puts one brother on each thumbstick, and a Switch port followed the original consoles.
titan-attacks: Puppy Games' score-attack blaster Titan Attacks! (2012) pays homage to Space Invaders, and Curve later published it on 3DS.
castlevania-los-mirror-of-fate-hd: MercurySteam's side-view adventure Castlevania: Lords of Shadow - Mirror of Fate (2013) debuted on 3DS inside the Lords of Shadow continuity, with HD ports afterward.
need-for-speed-the-run: EA's cross-country race against the clock is Need for Speed: The Run (2011), and the Wii and 3DS editions are separate from the HD drive.
zero-escape-zero-time-dilemma: Kotaro Uchikoshi closed the Zero Escape trilogy with Zero Escape: Zero Time Dilemma (2016), a 3DS, Vita, and PC adventure of locked-room choices.
urban-trial-freestyle: Obstacle courses and crashes define the bike-trials game URBAN TRIAL FREESTYLE (2013), which received a 3DS version.
bloodstained-curse-of-the-moon: Inti Creates made the 8-bit-style action game Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon (2018) with Koji Igarashi producing, and a 3DS version was released.
streets-of-rage-2: Sega's Streets of Rage 2 (1992) is the Genesis brawler usually ranked as the high point of that trilogy, later reissued on Virtual Console for Wii and 3DS.
pokemon-y: Game Freak took the main series fully into 3D with Pokémon X, Y (2013), introducing Mega Evolution on 3DS.
garfield-kart: Microids put the comic-strip cat in a budget kart racer, Garfield Kart (2013), on 3DS.
the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-3d: Grezzo remade the Nintendo 64 adventure for 3DS as The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D (2011), updated graphics and gyro aiming included.
pokemon-sun: Game Freak replaced gyms with island trials in the Alola games Pokémon Sun, Moon (2016), a 3DS pair built around Z-Moves.
pokemon-omega-ruby: Game Freak remade the Hoenn pair as Pokémon Alpha Sapphire, Omega Ruby (2014), bringing Mega Evolution back to those 3DS journeys.
super-mario-3d-land: Stereoscopic depth and a Tanooki suit define Nintendo's 3DS platformer Super Mario 3D Land (2011), an early showcase for the handheld.
wheel-of-fortune: The television word-puzzle show came to DS as Wheel of Fortune (2010), spinning a wheel and filling in letters.
warioware-touched: Intelligent Systems built WarioWare: Touched! (2004) around the DS touch screen and microphone, the first WarioWare made for that handheld.
you-dont-know-jack: Jackbox revived its sarcastic trivia show for touch screens as You Don't Know Jack HD (2011), a different product from the older console Jack games and not a DS original.
jagged-alliance: Sir-Tech's turn-based mercenary tactics game Jagged Alliance (1994) began on PC, long before any handheld version reused the name.
hotel-dusk-room-215: Cing's mystery Hotel Dusk: Room 215 (2007) is played with the DS held sideways like a book, a point-and-click set in a rundown hotel.
sega-superstars-tennis: Sumo Digital filled SEGA Superstars Tennis (2008) with Sega characters whose minigames nod at their own series, including a DS version.
mario-party-ds: Hudson brought the series' board and minigames to the dual screen in Mario Party DS (2007), with many events built around the stylus.
castlevania-portrait-of-ruin: Konami's DS search-action game Castlevania: Portrait of Ruin (2006) lets two heroes swap in and out during the castle crawl.
brain-challenge: Gameloft's set of short mental exercises Brain Challenge (2008) is a DS brain-training package from the boom that followed Nintendo's own series.
fire-emblem-shadow-dragon: Intelligent Systems remade the first Fire Emblem for DS as Fire Emblem: Shadow Dragon (2009), the Marth story western players had mostly missed.
nintendogs-labrador-friends: One of the three DS launch packs, Nintendogs: Labrador & Friends (2005) uses the touch screen and microphone to care for virtual puppies.
sonic-rush: Dimps brought a boost dash and tall dual-screen stages to DS in Sonic Rush (2005), a Sonic built for that handheld.
iron-man-2: The second Marvel film received Sega's action tie-in Iron Man 2 (2010), again with a DS game alongside the consoles.
dragons-lair-2-time-warp: Don Bluth's laserdisc sequel Dragon's Lair II: Time Warp (1991) continues the animated quick-time adventures that began with Dragon's Lair.
juiced-2-hot-import-nights: THQ's street-racing sequel Juiced 2: Hot Import Nights (2007) includes a DS edition made for that release.
puzzle-chronicles: Another match-puzzle RPG from the Puzzle Quest family, Puzzle Chronicles (2010) shipped with a DS version.
locks-quest: 5th Cell's DS strategy game Lock's Quest (2008) has you build walls by day and defend them when the siege starts at night.
cars-mater-national: Pixar's tow truck headlines the racing tie-in Disney•Pixar Cars Mater-National Championship (2007), and a DS version was part of that Cars spinoff.
professor-layton-and-the-last-specter: Level-5's fourth DS puzzle adventure Professor Layton and the Last Specter (2011) is a prequel, called Spectre's Call in Europe.
frogger-returns: Konami sent the arcade hopper back across traffic in the DS revival Frogger Returns (2009).
final-fantasy-tactics-a2-grimoire-of-the: Square Enix followed Final Fantasy Tactics Advance with the DS strategy RPG Final Fantasy Tactics A2: Grimoire of the Rift (2008), another Ivalice job system.
pokemon-mystery-dungeon-explorers-of-tim: Chunsoft's DS roguelike Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time (2008) is one half of the Explorers pair, alongside Explorers of Darkness.
pokemon-ranger-shadows-of-almia: The second stylus-capture spinoff, Pokémon Ranger: Shadows of Almia (2008), continues the DS line that began with Pokemon Ranger.
battleship: The naval film's licensed game BATTLESHIP (2012) shipped with a DS version in that same tie-in wave.
bejeweled-twist: PopCap replaced gem swapping with rotating clusters in Bejeweled Twist (2008), a match-three spinoff of Bejeweled.
simcity-3000: Maxis deepened zoning and added landmarks in the PC city builder SimCity 3000 (1999), a different game from the later DS SimCity.
mahjong: A DS solitaire take on the tile-matching table game, Mahjong (2009) clears pairs from a stacked layout.
space-ace: Don Bluth's laserdisc follow-up to Dragon's Lair is Space Ace, an animated quick-time game later reissued on DS.
the-settlers-2-veni-vidi-vici: Blue Byte's Roman village builder The Settlers 2: Veni, Vidi, Vici (1996) is a PC strategy game, remembered far from any DS shelf.
yoshis-island-ds: Artoon followed the Super Nintendo classic with Yoshi's Island DS (2006), a DS platformer that puts baby Mario on Yoshi's back again.
rocks-and-rockets: TikGames' DSiWare arcade game Rocks and Rockets (2011) shoots rockets at meteor waves before they hit a city.
the-sims-2-pets: EA's pet expansion The Sims 2: Pets (2006) added animals to the PC life sim, while the DS release is a separate handheld about looking after creatures.
rayman-raving-rabbids-2: Ubisoft turned the Rabbids into a party-minigame sequel, Rayman Raving Rabbids 2 (2007), and a DS version was part of that set.
f1-2011: Codemasters' official Formula 1 season is F1 2011, and the 3DS release is a cut-down handheld companion to the console sim.
kami: Flooding each sheet with a single color is the paper-fold puzzle KAMI, and a 3DS eShop version of that indie was released.
the-legend-of-zelda-majoras-mask-3d: Grezzo's 3DS remake The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D (2015) followed that studio's Ocarina of Time 3D, rebuilding the Nintendo 64 adventure with revised controls.
animal-crossing-new-leaf: The player becomes mayor in Animal Crossing: New Leaf (2012), the 3DS mainline Animal Crossing that towns lived in for years.
the-great-ace-attorney-chronicles: Capcom's The Great Ace Attorney Chronicles collects two historical courtroom games that began on 3DS in Japan in 2015, later bundled for a worldwide release.
fire-emblem-awakening: Intelligent Systems' 3DS tactics game Fire Emblem Awakening (2012) is widely credited with saving the series, thanks to casual mode and unit pairing.
alter-world: Hopping between alternate versions of a stage is the idea of Alter World, a platformer first sold on the New Nintendo 3DS eShop.
pokemon-ultra-sun: Game Freak expanded the Alola pair as Pokémon Ultra Sun, Ultra Moon (2017), a 3DS follow-up with a larger story than Sun and Moon.
mario-kart-7: Hang gliders and underwater driving arrived in Nintendo's Mario Kart 7 (2011), the kart racer built for 3DS.
puyo-puyo-tetris: Sonic Team crossed Puyo blobs with falling tetrominoes in Puyo Puyo Tetris (2014), a versus puzzle that reached 3DS.
bloo-kid-2: Short hop-and-run stages make up the indie platformer Bloo Kid 2 (2014), a numbered sequel on the 3DS eShop.
new-super-mario-bros-2: Coin rush is the obsession of Nintendo's New Super Mario Bros. 2 (2012), a 3DS side-scroller built around grabbing huge totals.
gunman-clive: Horberg Productions' sketch-styled western Gunman Clive (2012) is a small 3DS eShop platformer that punched above its price.
batman-arkham-origins-blackgate: Armature Studio's side-view Metroidvania Batman: Arkham Origins Blackgate (2013) is a Blackgate prison side story on 3DS and Vita, between the console Arkham games.
metroid-samus-returns: MercurySteam remade Metroid II for 3DS as Metroid: Samus Returns (2017), adding a melee counter to Samus's hunt.
slay-the-spire: MegaCrit's deck-building climb Slay the Spire (2019) turned a roguelike card game into a huge hit, and Switch was one of its platforms.
drawful-2: Jackbox's party game Drawful 2 (2016) has players draw terrible prompts so friends can guess the caption.
vampire-survivors: poncle's Vampire Survivors (2022) swarms the screen while attacks fire on their own, a breakout auto-battler that came to Switch.
dragons-dogma-dark-arisen: Capcom's expanded re-release Dragon's Dogma: Dark Arisen (2013) adds the Bitterblack Isle dungeon to Dragon's Dogma, and a Switch port followed.
resident-evil-village: Capcom's Resident Evil: Village (2021) continues the first-person story from Resident Evil 7, a village horror sequel in the main line.
abzu-2: Giant Squid, founded by Journey art director Matt Nava, made the wordless ocean dive ABZU (2016), later ported to Switch.
oxenfree: Night School Studio's teen supernatural mystery Oxenfree (2016) is told through walking conversations, and a Switch port followed.
tales-from-the-borderlands: Telltale's episodic comedy Tales from the Borderlands: A Telltale Game Series (2015) adapts the Borderlands universe as a choice-driven story, later collected on Switch.
broken-age: Double Fine's Kickstarted adventure Broken Age (2014) shipped in two acts after a long gap, and a Switch version came later.
dying-light: Techland's parkour zombie game Dying Light (2015) makes daylight scavenging safer than the night, and a Switch port followed.
sonic-mania: Christian Whitehead, Headcannon, and PagodaWest returned to classic Sonic physics in Sonic Mania (2017), and Switch was one of its platforms.
the-talos-principle: Croteam's first-person puzzle game The Talos Principle (2014) asks philosophical questions between laser and block puzzles, later on Switch.
gris: Nomada Studio's wordless platformer Gris (2018) uses watercolor stages and almost no combat, and it came to Switch.
vampyr: Dontnod's action RPG Vampyr (2018) follows a doctor turned vampire in 1918 London, and a Switch port came later.
outer-wilds: Mobius Digital's Outer Wilds (2019) is a space mystery on a 22-minute loop, widely praised, and later ported to Switch.
the-flame-in-the-flood: The Molasses Flood's river-raft survival game The Flame in the Flood (2016) is a roguelike trip downstream, later released on Switch.
deponia: Daedalic's comedy point-and-click Deponia (2012) started a German adventure series, and a Switch port collected that trip later.
rogue-legacy: Cellar Door Games' Rogue Legacy (2013) sends a new heir into the castle each time you die, a roguelike platformer later on Switch.
crash-bandicoot-n-sane-trilogy: Vicarious Visions rebuilt the first three Crash games as Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy (2017), and that remaster collection reached Switch.
dust-an-elysian-tail: Dean Dodrill largely made the action RPG Dust: An Elysian Tail (2012) alone for Xbox Live Arcade, and a Switch port followed years later.
sniper-elite-4: Rebellion set the WWII marksman game Sniper Elite 4 (2017) in Italy, famous for its bullet-camera shots, and a Switch version followed.
life-is-strange-2: Dontnod's episodic sequel Life is Strange 2 (2018) tells a new road-trip story rather than continuing the first game's lead, and it reached Switch.
machinarium: Amanita Design's robot point-and-click Machinarium (2009) has almost no written dialogue, and a Switch port followed the PC original.
valiant-hearts-the-great-war: Ubisoft Montpellier's puzzle adventure Valiant Hearts: The Great War (2014) follows ordinary people through World War I, later ported to Switch.
yakuza-kiwami: Sega's Yakuza Kiwami (2016) is a ground-up remake of the first Yakuza, the Kamurocho crime story that started on PlayStation 2.
stalker-call-of-pripyat: GSC Game World's third Zone shooter S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Pripyat (2009) followed Shadow of Chernobyl as a PC sequel set around Pripyat.
guardians-of-the-galaxy: Eidos-Montreal's single-player action game Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy (2021) is a separate project from Telltale's earlier Guardians series.
the-lego-ninjago-movie-video-game: TT Games' brick tie-in to the Ninjago film is The LEGO NINJAGO Movie Video Game, released in the same year as that movie across several consoles.
stalker-clear-sky: GSC Game World's prequel S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky (2008) is the second S.T.A.L.K.E.R. release, set before Shadow of Chernobyl on PC.
outlast-2: Red Barrels followed its camcorder horror with Outlast 2 (2017), a rural sequel that kept the defenseless first-person filming.
overcooked-2: Ghost Town Games' kitchen panic sequel Overcooked! 2 (2018) throws new hazards at cooperating chefs, and Switch was a major platform.
ghostrunner: One More Level's first-person cyber-ninja Ghostrunner (2020) is built around dying in one hit and restarting the run, including a Switch version.
star-wars-jedi-knight-jedi-academy: Raven Software's Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy (2003) is the third Jedi Knight shooter, letting players build a lightsaber moveset, and Aspyr later ported it to Switch.
gone-home: Fullbright's exploration game Gone Home (2013) tells a family story by walking through an empty house, and a Switch port followed.
final-fantasy-vii: Square's PlayStation RPG Final Fantasy VII (1997) took the series into 3D, and that original version later reached Switch.
katana-zero: Askiisoft's neo-noir action game Katana ZERO (2019) rewinds deaths in short cinematic rooms, and it launched with a Switch version.
shadowrun-dragonfall-dc: Harebrained Schemes expanded a Shadowrun Returns campaign into Shadowrun: Dragonfall - Director's Cut in 2014, a standalone cyberpunk tactics RPG with a fuller version of that story.
inside: Playdead followed Limbo with INSIDE in 2016, another wordless side-view puzzle story about a boy slipping through a grim facility. Critics treated it as one of that year's standout games.
sega-mega-drive-and-genesis-classics: Sega began shipping SEGA Mega Drive and Genesis Classics on PC in 2010, a growing compilation of Mega Drive and Genesis games that later consolidated onto consoles.
brawlhalla: Blue Mammoth Games put the free platform fighter Brawlhalla into early access in 2014. It plays in the Smash mold and later came under Ubisoft.
firewatch: Campo Santo's first game, Firewatch, arrived in 2016 as a first-person story set at a Wyoming fire lookout, told largely through radio talks with a supervisor.
assassins-creed-odyssey: Ubisoft Quebec set Assassin's Creed Odyssey in ancient Greece in 2018, with a dialogue-heavy RPG structure and a choice between siblings Alexios and Kassandra.
no-mans-sky: Hello Games launched the procedural space explorer No Man's Sky in 2016 to a harsh reception, then spent years adding bases, story, and multiplayer.
alien-isolation: Creative Assembly's 2014 Alien: Isolation strands Amanda Ripley on a space station with one xenomorph, fifteen years after the 1979 film.
disco-elysium: ZA/UM's 2019 Disco Elysium is a detective RPG in the city of Revachol with no ordinary combat, and it swept a long list of year-end awards.
cuphead: Studio MDHR spent years on Cuphead before the 2017 release, a boss-rush run-and-gun drawn and scored like a 1930s rubber-hose cartoon.
darksiders: Vigil Games, under THQ, opened its horseman series with Darksiders in 2010, putting War through a combat adventure often compared with Zelda.
doom-eternal: id Software followed its 2016 reboot with DOOM Eternal in 2020, a faster demon shooter that makes the player manage ammo, armor, and health from the enemies themselves.
among-us: InnerSloth released the social-deduction game Among Us in 2018, about finding an impostor aboard a ship. Its huge popularity spike came a couple of years later.
transistor: Supergiant Games followed Bastion with Transistor in 2014, an isometric action RPG whose fights can be paused and planned.
resident-evil-5-biohazard-5: Capcom's 2009 Resident Evil 5 teams Chris Redfield with Sheva Alomar and pushes the series further into co-op shooting.
xcom-2: Firaxis reversed the 2012 reboot's outcome in XCOM 2, a 2016 turn-based tactics game where the aliens have already occupied Earth.
ori-and-the-blind-forest-definitive-edit: Moon Studios' platformer gained a new area and difficulty options in Ori and the Blind Forest: Definitive Edition, the 2016 expansion of the 2015 original.
red-dead-redemption: Rockstar San Diego's open-world Western Red Dead Redemption arrived in 2010 with John Marston as its lead, and later ports carried it to newer hardware.
civilization-vi: Firaxis added city districts to the long strategy series in Sid Meier’s Civilization VI, the 2016 entry where urban sprawl matters as much as the capital tile.
trine-2-complete-story: Frozenbyte bundled its puzzle platformer and the Goblin Menace expansion as Trine 2: Complete Story in 2013, still starring a thief, a knight, and a wizard.
this-war-of-mine: 11 bit studios shifted war games onto civilians with This War of Mine in 2014, a scavenging sim inspired by accounts of the siege of Sarajevo.
call-of-juarez-gunslinger: Techland's 2013 Call of Juarez: Gunslinger is a first-person Western narrated by a bounty hunter whose tall tales rewrite the level as he talks.
dead-cells: Motion Twin brought the roguelike metroidvania Dead Cells to a 1.0 release in 2018 after a long early access, with runs that keep combat upgrades rare between deaths.
wolfenstein-2-the-new-colossus: MachineGames continued its alternate-history shooter in 2017 with Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus, following B.J. Blazkowicz through a Nazi-occupied America.
divinity-original-sin-2: Larian's co-op computer RPG Divinity: Original Sin 2 landed in 2017 and became the studio's calling card before Baldur's Gate 3.
a-plague-tale-innocence: Asobo Studio set A Plague Tale: Innocence in plague-era France in 2019, following two siblings through swarms of rats.
subnautica: Unknown Worlds set the survival game Subnautica under an alien ocean. A full release followed years of early access in 2018.
south-park-the-stick-of-truth: Obsidian made the role-playing game South Park: The Stick of Truth with the show's creators. Ubisoft published it in 2014 after THQ collapsed.
fallout-shelter: Bethesda's free vault manager Fallout Shelter started on mobile in 2015, letting players build rooms, assign dwellers, and ride out disasters.
darkest-dungeon: Red Hook Studios shipped Darkest Dungeon in 2016, a dungeon crawl in which stress can shatter a party as surely as wounds do.
fez: Phil Fish and Polytron released the perspective-rotating puzzle platformer FEZ in 2012, years after it first drew attention at indie shows.
star-wars-knights-of-the-old-republic-2: BioWare's 2003 Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic is the Xbox and PC role-playing game set thousands of years before the films, not the later MMO.
castle-crashers: The Behemoth's four-player beat-em-up Castle Crashers became a signature Xbox Live Arcade hit after its 2008 debut.
batman-arkham-city-2: Rocksteady opened up a sealed slice of Gotham in Batman: Arkham City, the 2011 sequel to Arkham Asylum.
superhot: Time moves only when the player does in SUPERHOT, the 2016 shooter built around that single rule.
what-remains-of-edith-finch: Giant Sparrow's 2017 What Remains of Edith Finch walks through one cursed family's stories, and it later won the BAFTA for best game.
torchlight-ii: Runic Games followed its dungeon crawler with Torchlight II in 2012, an action RPG known for co-op and a mod-friendly PC release.
corpse-party: Corpse Party is the Japanese horror adventure about students trapped after a friendship charm fails. It began as a 1996 PC-98 game and spread through later remakes.
goosebumps-the-game: WayForward's Goosebumps: The Game is a 2015 tie-in to the Goosebumps film, drawing monsters from R.L. Stine's children's horror books.
adventure-time-finn-and-jake-investigati: The cartoon leads become a detective pair in Adventure Time: Finn and Jake Investigations, a 2015 adventure set in Pendleton Ward's world.
bravely-default: Square Enix brought Bravely Default west in 2014. The 3DS RPG, made with Silicon Studio, hangs its battles on a job system plus Brave and Default commands.
tetris-ultimate: Ubisoft's multiplatform Tetris Ultimate arrived in 2014 and drew poor notices for a clumsy take on the classic falling-block puzzle.
pes-2011: Konami's soccer annual Pro Evolution Soccer 2011, released in 2010, continued the long rivalry with EA's FIFA.
luigis-mansion-dark-moon: Next Level Games returned to the vacuum-cleaner ghost hunt with Luigi's Mansion: Dark Moon in 2013, known as Luigi's Mansion 2 in some regions.
zero-escape-virtues-last-reward: Chunsoft followed 999 with Zero Escape: Virtue's Last Reward in 2012, another escape-room visual novel directed by Kotaro Uchikoshi.
gunstar-heroes: Treasure's Sega Genesis run-and-gun Gunstar Heroes arrived in 1993, famous for combining weapons, and later reappeared in Sega's 3D Classics line.
fire-emblem-fates-birthright: Intelligent Systems split Fire Emblem Fates into separate campaigns in 2016. Fire Emblem Fates: Birthright is the Hoshido route, usually treated as the easier path.
fire-emblem-echoes-shadows-of-valentia: Intelligent Systems remade the 1992 Famicom game Gaiden as Fire Emblem Echoes: Shadows of Valentia in 2017, keeping the split between two armies.
dragon-quest-viii: Level-5's PlayStation 2 RPG Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King arrived in 2004 with Akira Toriyama's designs, and a 3DS port followed years later.
transformers-rotds: The 2014 action game TRANSFORMERS: Rise of the Dark Spark links the live-action toys with the War for Cybertron games through the Dark Spark.
angry-birds-star-wars: Rovio reskinned its slingshot puzzle as Angry Birds Star Wars in 2012, swapping the birds and pigs for characters and vehicles from the films.
kung-fu-rabbit: French studio cTools shipped the mobile platformer Kung Fu Rabbit in 2012, starring a rabbit who teaches kung fu. Console editions followed with Neko Entertainment.
ace-attorney-dual-destinies: Capcom's fifth main Ace Attorney game, Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Dual Destinies, arrived on the 3DS in 2013 in full 3D and introduced Athena Cykes.
shovel-knight-specter-of-torment: Yacht Club Games made Shovel Knight: Specter of Torment in 2017 as a prequel campaign about Specter Knight, also folded into the Treasure Trove package.
shakedown-hawaii: Vblank Entertainment, the studio behind Retro City Rampage, released the open-world crime game Shakedown: Hawaii in 2019.
fire-emblem-fates-conquest: The harder half of the 2016 split, Fire Emblem Fates: Conquest, follows the Nohr family and limits the grinding the sister campaign allows.
kid-icarus-uprising: Project Sora and Masahiro Sakurai revived the series on the 3DS with Kid Icarus: Uprising in 2012, mixing on-rails air battles with ground fights.
the-sims-3-pets: The pet-focused Sims release The Sims 3 Pets arrived in 2011. On PC it was an expansion; consoles and handhelds got a standalone game instead.
galaga: Namco's 1981 arcade shooter Galaga followed Galaxian and made the tractor beam its signature, yanking the player's ship up to be captured.
wwe-all-stars: THQ's 2011 WWE All Stars drops simulation rules for an arcade wrestler of oversized legends and then-current stars.
dig-dug: Namco's 1982 arcade game DIG DUG has the player tunnel under the ground, inflate enemies until they pop, and drop rocks on them.
azure-striker-gunvolt: Inti Creates, staffed by Mega Man veterans, released Azure Striker Gunvolt in 2014, a side-scroller about tagging foes and unleashing a flash field.
angry-birds-trilogy: Activision's 2012 Angry Birds Trilogy packs the original slingshot game, Seasons, and Rio onto home consoles.
quell-memento: Fallen Tree Games' third droplet puzzle, Quell Memento, keeps the series' calm logic mazes and frames them as sorting through scattered memories.
skylanders-giants: Activision's second toys-to-life Skylanders game, Skylanders Giants, arrived in 2012 and added oversized Giant figures beside the returning cast.
shin-megami-tensei-iv: Atlus set Shin Megami Tensei IV in a kingdom sealed over a ruined Tokyo. The 2013 3DS RPG became many players' first mainline SMT game.
ecco-the-dolphin-1992: Novotrade's Sega Genesis adventure Ecco the Dolphin (1992) follows a dolphin cut off from his pod, and it is remembered for a steep, strange difficulty.
spirit-of-justice: Capcom's sixth main Ace Attorney game, Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Spirit of Justice, took Phoenix Wright to the kingdom of Khura'in in 2016.
gunslugs: Orangepixel's tiny run-and-gun Gunslugs started on mobile in 2013, sending a squad against the Black Duck Army.
6180-the-moon: Turtle Cream's puzzle platformer 6180 the moon wraps the screen from bottom to top, so a fall drops you back in from above. The number is how many seconds the first prototype took.
elliot-quest: Ansimuz built Elliot Quest in 2014 as an action RPG openly modeled on Zelda II, with side-view combat and an island of dungeons.
quell-reflect-2: Fallen Tree Games placed Quell Reflect between the original Quell and later Memento, another calm puzzle about steering a droplet through logic mazes.
fire-emblem-warriors: Omega Force, Team Ninja, and Intelligent Systems crossed Fire Emblem with the Warriors brawler format in Fire Emblem Warriors in 2017, on Switch and New 3DS.
80s-overdrive: Insane Code's retro racer 80'S OVERDRIVE, released in 2017, chases the OutRun mood of sunset highways and a synth-styled soundtrack.
skylanders-swap-force: The third toys-to-life entry, Skylanders SWAP Force, arrived in 2013 with figures that split into swappable top and bottom halves.
the-legend-of-dark-witch: Japanese indie studio INSIDE SYSTEM released The Legend of Dark Witch in 2014, a Mega Man-style action platformer about a witch who takes powers from bosses.
mario-luigi-dream-team: AlphaDream's 3DS RPG Mario & Luigi: Dream Team, released in 2013, turns Luigi's dreams into both the overworld gimmick and the battles.
fire-emblem-fates-revelation: The third 2016 route, Fire Emblem Fates: Revelation, joins the Hoshido and Nohr armies and was sold apart from the two main campaigns.
the-keep: Czech studio Cinemax made The Keep in 2014 as a first-person dungeon crawler for the 3DS, with real-time combat and rune magic inside a wizard's tower.
adventure-time-the-secret-of-the-nameles: WayForward's 2014 Adventure Time: The Secret of the Nameless Kingdom turns Finn and Jake's cartoon into a top-down dungeon-crawling adventure.
professor-layton-vs-ace-attorney: Level-5 and Capcom crossed their puzzle and courtroom series in Professor Layton vs. Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney, first released in Japan in 2012.
kirby-triple-deluxe: HAL Laboratory's 2014 3DS platformer Kirby: Triple Deluxe uses the handheld's depth and gives Kirby a Hypernova inhale that swallows huge objects.
pixel-hunter: Lemondo's voxel side-scroller Pixel Hunter first appeared on PC in 2014, sending a hunter through themed stages to take back stolen weapons.
super-smash-bros-for-nintendo-3ds: Bandai Namco and Sora Ltd. shipped Super Smash Bros. for Nintendo 3DS in 2014 as the portable half of that generation's Smash, alongside a separate Wii U game.
skylanders-spyros-adventure: Toys for Bob started the toys-to-life boom with Skylanders Spyro's Adventure in 2011, storing each character's progress in a figure placed on a portal.
kirby-planet-robobot: HAL Laboratory gave Kirby a pilotable mech in Kirby: Planet Robobot, the 2016 3DS game often ranked with the strongest mainline Kirby releases.
persona-q-shadow-of-the-labyrinth: Atlus crossed Persona 3 and Persona 4 with Etrian Odyssey-style mapping in Persona Q: Shadow of the Labyrinth, a 2014 3DS dungeon RPG.
the-legend-of-zelda-tri-force-heroes: Nintendo built The Legend of Zelda: Tri Force Heroes in 2015 for three players on the 3DS, stacking Links to reach switches and fight.
blaster-master-zero: Inti Creates reimagined the NES classic in Blaster Master Zero in 2017, keeping the swap between a tank and on-foot cavern exploration.
spyro-reignited-trilogy: Toys for Bob remade the first three PlayStation games as Spyro Reignited Trilogy in 2018, rebuilding Spyro, Ripto's Rage, and Year of the Dragon.
risk-of-rain-2: Hopoo Games moved its roguelike from a side view into 3D with Risk of Rain 2, which left early access in 2020.
blasphemous: The Game Kitchen's 2019 Blasphemous is a severe side-view action game steeped in Spanish Catholic imagery and pixel art.
kholat: IMGN.PRO's 2015 first-person horror game Kholat draws on the Dyatlov Pass incident, with the player lost in the snowy Ural mountains.
surgeon-simulator-cpr: Bossa Studios' physics comedy Surgeon Simulator arrived in 2013, with each finger of a clumsy surgeon controlled on its own.
sniper-elite-3: Rebellion moved its X-ray sharpshooter to the North African campaign in Sniper Elite 3, released in 2014.
genshin-impact: miHoYo launched the free-to-play open-world action RPG Genshin Impact in 2020, built around elemental character swaps and a gacha roster.
serious-sam-the-first-encounter: Croteam's 2001 arena shooter Serious Sam: The First Encounter throws huge waves of enemies at the player and forms the first half of the original Serious Sam.
furi: The Game Bakers' 2016 boss rush Furi alternates sword fights with shooting, one duel after another and almost no ordinary levels between them.
doom-3: id Software rebuilt the series as a slower Mars horror shooter in Doom 3, the 2004 game famous for its darkness and flashlight.
titan-quest: Iron Lore's 2006 action RPG Titan Quest walks a mythic ancient world from Greece through Egypt and onward, with loot-driven combat.
serious-sam-hd-tfe: Croteam's 2009 remaster Serious Sam HD:  The First Encounter updates the look of the 2001 wave shooter without changing its crowd-combat design.
banner-saga: Stoic's Viking caravan RPG The Banner Saga arrived in 2014, pairing turn-based fights with a travel story drawn in a storybook style.
crypt-of-the-necrodancer: Brace Yourself Games locked movement to the soundtrack in Crypt of the NecroDancer, the 2015 roguelike where missing the beat means missing the step.
darksiders-iii: Gunfire Games put the horseman Fury in the lead for Darksiders III in 2018, a narrower action game than the earlier open-world entries.
the-vanishing-of-ethan-carter: Former People Can Fly developers at The Astronauts released the first-person mystery The Vanishing of Ethan Carter in 2014, later reissued as Redux.
plague-inc-evolved: Ndemic Creations expanded its mobile plague sim for PC and consoles as Plague Inc: Evolved in 2015, adding modes around the original infection puzzle.
hogwarts-legacy: Avalanche Software's open-world action RPG Hogwarts Legacy, published by Portkey Games in 2023, is set in the 1890s of the Harry Potter world.
unravel: Coldwood Interactive's yarn-figure platformer Unravel, published by EA in 2016, follows the little character Yarny through physics puzzles.
speedrunners: DoubleDutch Games released the competitive runner SpeedRunners in 2016, a side-view race built on grapples and shoving rivals off the screen.
moonlighter: Digital Sun's 2018 Moonlighter splits each day between dungeon runs and minding a shop that sells whatever you carried out.
gothic-1: Piranha Bytes' PC role-playing game Gothic arrived in 2001, set in a prison colony trapped under a magic barrier, and later gathered a cult following.
risk-of-rain: Hopoo Games' 2013 side-view roguelike Risk of Rain makes every minute harsher, and it is the game later remade in 3D as a sequel.
remnant-from-the-ashes: Gunfire Games combined shooter combat with procedurally arranged worlds in Remnant: From the Ashes, released in 2019.
rime: Tequila Works' 2017 puzzle adventure RiME follows a boy across a Mediterranean island and tells the story with very little dialogue.
south-park-the-fractured-but-whole: Ubisoft's 2017 sequel South Park: The Fractured But Whole moves the kids from a fantasy stick fight to a homemade superhero game.
this-is-the-police: Weappy's 2016 management game This is the Police follows a corrupt chief, Jack Boyd, through his last 180 days in the job.
factorio: Wube Software's factory builder Factorio is about automating a hostile planet. Version 1.0 arrived in 2020 after a long early access.
golf-with-your-friends: The mini-golf party game Golf With Your Friends entered early access in 2016 and later reached a wider console release with Team17 publishing.
my-friend-pedro: DeadToast Entertainment's slow-motion shooter My Friend Pedro, published by Devolver Digital in 2019, takes orders from a talking banana.
